FX-STRETCH-001.says: The settings as they start: scale 100, so nothing changes.

FX-STRETCH-002.says: Scale 200: the right half stretched twice as wide, from the middle.

FX-STRETCH-003.says: Scale 400, direction 90: the bottom half stretched four times down.

FX-STRETCH-004.says: Scale 100000: the right half a streak of the middle column.

FX-STRETCH-006.says: Center [25, 30], scale 250: stretched from a line further left.

FX-STRETCH-007.says: Center [-20, 50], scale 150: the line off the drawing to the left, the whole drawing stretched, its left edge pulled in from outside it.

FX-STRETCH-008.says: Direction 180, scale 300: the left half stretched to the left.

FX-STRETCH-009.says: Scale keyed from 100 at frame 0 to 500 at frame 4, linear: frame 2 is scale 300.

FX-STRETCH-010.says: Direction keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 90 at frame 4, linear, scale 300: frame 2 is direction 45.

FX-STRETCH-011.says: FX-STRETCH-002 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-STRETCH-013.says: Scale 99, below 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STRETCH-014.says: Scale 100001, above 100000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STRETCH-015.says: Center y -1001, below -1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STRETCH-016.says: Direction 3601, above 3600. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STRETCH-017.says: Scale keyed to 200000 at frame 4: a key outside the range. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
